grants: Unattended publication, on the channel's due day and at most one Short per day, of a premium Short that passes every check under requires, without a per-video review. For such a Short this policy is the creative, factual and publish sign-off; each approval record names this file's sha256. Code never signs this file.
requires: research: the researched case file (icerik/konular/<slug>.json) qualified in the Failure Reconstructed topic universe (QUALIFIED, production_ready) with its source URLs and failure chain: the FR live research standard, no stored verbatim quotes
topic: unpublished, not generated or failed in the live pipeline, not reserved, not blocked for its content
render: a fresh final render by the premium studio (automatic storyboard) with the channel's owner-approved voice only; no preview fallback voice
objective QA: PASS on every hard check (resolution, decode, black and frozen frames, loudness and true peak, captions, text layout, real speech, determinism)
publish gate (scripts/bto-studio/publish-gate.js): PUBLISH_APPROVED, which includes registry publishing enabled and every image plate licensed in the asset registry
duplicates: neither the topic nor the exact media in published.json; the uploader's own identity check, journal and remote reconciliation
upload: private with the channel's scheduled publishAt on the due day, through youtube-yukle.js; metadata from the topic's own research and sources
doesNotCover: topics whose research is below the standard above
licensing or factual uncertainty flagged by any gate
a new or changed narration voice
any change to channel identity or credentials
activation: sign: set status SIGNED, signedBy and signedAt (ISO time). It takes effect only with FR_PREMIUM_PUBLISH=1 and, for this channel, FR_PREMIUM_PRIMARY=1, plus config/channels.json enabled: true.
revoke: set status REVOKED (or unset the repository variable). Records already bound keep naming the sha256 they were bound to.
approval: Owner approval 2026-10-28 in the Claude Code session (decision B: Premium Engine primary for Failure Reconstructed; policy signed within the stated scope). Applied by Claude on the owner's instruction.
